title: WASD Cloth for Blender
summary: Cloth made with Blender's Cloth modifier from scripts: drapes settled onto props, wind loops baked into shape keys, and bone chains for capes and skirts.
useWhen: Props need draped fabric (tablecloths, sheets, tarps), a flag or sail needs a looping wind animation, or a character's cape, skirt, or coat needs bone chains for wasd-cloth.
avoidWhen: Cloth that the player pushes while the game runs: use wasd-cloth's soft-body sheets in Godot.
